newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-GERMAN RAIDER SPRINGS GROUP ONE SURPRISE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-GERMAN RAIDER SPRINGS GROUP ONE SURPRISE.

text.p: German-trained winners of French group one races are few and far between, but A Magicman defied convention to land a 22.5-1 surprise in seven-furlong (1.4 km) Prix de la Foret at Longchamp on Sunday.
Longchamp and soft ground seem to be the key ingredients to bring out the best in A Magicman, who raced in the mid-division early on for jockey Andreas Suborics.

The three leaders in the two-year-old contest, Hamirpour, General Monash and Tagula, all came back to the field in the straight, as A Magicman was kicked into the lead on the outside with a furlong (200 metres) to go.
A Magicman then had to withstand the strong-finishing Miesque's Son, but the post came in time with the winner hanging on by a head.

Miesque's Son, ridden by Cash Asmussen, would probably have won in another stride or two. Shaanxi, the mount of Olivier Peslier, ran her usual honest race to take third a further three quarters of a length back.
Suborics said: "This was A Magicman's best career-performance. He flies in the mud and loves the Paris track. This was his second group success here."
English-trained Mistle Cat refused to enter the stalls which meant a wasted trip for jockey Wendyll Woods who had jetted in from Hong Kong for the ride.
Earlier, Anabaa struck another blow for the all-conquering John Gosden-Frankie Dettori team by landing a two length win in the group two Prix du Conseil de Paris.
It was Anabaa's second group success at the course and trainer Gosden has now saddled six French winners in a 15-day period.
